FQHECylinderRealSpacePartitionCoefficients, version 0.01

Usage: FQHECylinderRealSpacePartitionCoefficients [options] 

Options:

system options:

    --finite-patch : use a patch with a finite length and optionally a finite width

    --patch-length : length of the patch along the cylinder axis (default value = 1)
    --patch-width : width of the patch along the cylinder perimeter (0 if it should extend along the whole cylinder perimeter) (default value = 0)

output options:

    --column-output : when having a cut preserving the translation along the cylinder perimeter, use a column formatted output instead of a single line
